description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with vector store, OpenAI API, and custom utilities to facilitate question-answering based on textbook chapters.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing vector storage and search functionalities for textual data.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs embedding, search, and generates a context-aware answer using OpenAI's chat completion API.
